label: Bible Study
prompt: But the LORD sent out a great wind into the sea, and there was a mighty _____ in the sea, so that the ship was like to be broken.
verse: But the LORD sent out a great wind into the sea, and there was a mighty tempest in the sea, so that the ship was like to be broken.
note: God sends the storm after the runaway prophet — the sailors are praying long before Jonah is.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Blessed are the _____ in heart: for they shall see God.
verse: Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see God.
note: The pure in heart get the best reward on the whole mountainside: they shall see God Himself.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And till Moses had done speaking with them, he put a _____ on his face.
verse: And till Moses had done speaking with them, he put a vail on his face.
note: The KJV spells it 'vail' — Moses' face shone so brightly after meeting God that he had to cover it.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And the goat shall bear upon him all their iniquities unto a land not _____: and he shall let go the goat in the wilderness.
verse: And the goat shall bear upon him all their iniquities unto a land not inhabited: and he shall let go the goat in the wilderness.
note: The Day of Atonement scapegoat carried Israel's sins off into the wilderness, never to wander back.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: My doctrine shall drop as the rain, my speech shall _____ as the dew, as the small rain upon the tender herb, and as the showers upon the grass:
verse: My doctrine shall drop as the rain, my speech shall distil as the dew, as the small rain upon the tender herb, and as the showers upon the grass:
note: Moses' farewell song opens softly: 'my speech shall distil as the dew' — and the KJV spells it with a single l.
